title: Ten losses: VaR and expected shortfall
caption: The two worst of ten equally likely losses, 20 and 50, are the 20% tail. The 80% VaR is only 8, the threshold, but the expected shortfall averages the tail: (20 + 50)/2 = 35.
alt: Ten bars of losses 1 to 8, 20 and 50, with the two largest highlighted.
description: ES = (20 + 50)/2 = 35, far above the VaR of 8.
